text: As a part of the Ontario Line project, Metrolinx has identified Car Park 89, located at 20 Eaton Avenue, as a preferred location to stage the construction of the Pape Interchange Station (the "Project"). A number of other City-owned properties, including 743 Pape Avenue and 25 Lipton Avenue, have also been identified as being required to support the Project. Car Park 89 has been identified by Metrolinx as the most suitable location to stage the Project given that Pape Station will be partially demolished and rebuilt within the future Pape Interchange Station and the subway tunnel will be constructed through City lands. Metrolinx has therefore requested the use of the Toronto Parking Authority lands through the City’s Real Estate Protocol for the Province of Ontario’s Priority Transit Projects, which includes the Ontario Line. To facilitate the temporary closure of Car Park 89, Metrolinx…

The Board of Directors of Toronto Parking Authority: 1. Authorized the President, Toronto Parking Authority, to request the Executive Director, Corporate Real Estate Management to enter into a licence agreement on behalf of the City of Toronto with Metrolinx concerning 20 Eaton Avenue (Car Park 89) in accordance with the Terms and Conditions outlined in Table 2 of this report (November 9, 2023) from the President, Toronto Parking Authority, and any such other amended terms and conditions as may be acceptable to the Executive Director, Corporate Real Estate Management and the City Solicitor as to provide compensation for the loss of parking space revenues and other expenses related to the Metrolinx occupation of the entirety of Car Park 89.
